summary: Practise EDR alert investigation, endpoint scoping, containment, and reporting. Explore the course outline and delivery requirements.
lede: Endpoint detection and response training helps security operations professionals practise investigating alerts and scoping suspicious activity in an EDR console. Designed for SOC analysts, incident responders and endpoint security practitioners with basic experience, it covers alert validation, process and network evidence review, incident timelines, containment decisions and reporting, with awareness of AI-assisted triage and mapping investigations to ATT&CK tactics and techniques.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for security operations professionals who investigate endpoint alerts, coordinate containment, or review incident evidence. It suits practitioners with basic SOC or incident response experience who need structured practice in an EDR console. SOC Analyst responsible for validating endpoint detection alerts and escalating incidents. Incident Responder who scopes affected hosts and coordinates containment decisions. Endpoint Security Analyst who reviews process, file, and network telemetry. Threat Hunter who investigates suspicious endpoint behaviours and activity patterns. SOC Team Lead who reviews investigation quality and escalation records. Digital Forensics Analyst who preserves endpoint evidence for incident timelines. Security Operations Engineer who tunes endpoint detection and response workflows. Cybersecurity Incident Manager who coordinates response tasks across technical teams. Threat Intelligence Analyst who maps endpoint indicators to MITRE ATT&CK techniques. IT Security Administrator who supports endpoint isolation and recovery procedures.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with SOC alert triage, endpoint security concepts, and basic incident response terminology is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop if the delivery format uses hands-on labs. Access to a working EDR training tenant and its required licence must be confirmed before delivery; the vendor platform is not specified in the course brief.
